inferred_dimensions_need_confirmation.note: These dimensions are inferred from weight calculation — not explicitly shown on drawing. Must be confirmed before production.

drawing_clarifications.description: 10 mm walls inferred from weight — confirm explicitly on drawing
45 mm derived from 15+20+10 — confirm on drawing
Add 'THRU TOP WEB' or equivalent depth note to drawing
No permissible radius specified. WEDM leaves ~R0.15–0.20. Specify R0.2 max or confirm acceptable radius with designer.
Specify exact grade e.g. IS 2062 E250 if material properties matter

process_sequence.name: Manual milling — face datum A
process_sequence.machine: Universal milling machine (VISPL-TLR-001) or Vertical ram precision milling machine (VISPL-TLR-003)
actions: Face first large surface — establish datum A

process_sequence.name: Manual milling — finish thickness
process_sequence.machine: Universal or vertical ram milling machine

process_sequence.name: Manual milling — square and finish outside block
process_sequence.machine: Universal or vertical ram milling machine
sequence: Mill opposite long side to 50.0 mm width
Mill opposite end to 45.0 mm overall height
process_sequence.inspection: Vernier, height gauge and engineer's square
process_sequence.note: ±0.2 mm tolerance on one-decimal dimensions — careful manual milling is sufficient. Surface grinding optional for better flatness/parallelism.

process_sequence.name: WEDM — internal profile
why_wedm: WEDM produces much smaller internal corner radius than end mill
Profile is open to bottom — no start hole needed
Both parts can be stacked and cut together
process_sequence.datum_setup: Bottom-left corner of front face = X0, Y0
wedm_profile_coordinates: Start at bottom edge: X30, Y0
wedm_procedure: Establish zero from finished left and bottom surfaces
Support removable slug to prevent wire breakage
At least one skim cut on main opening
Lightly stone burr/wire-start area only — do not round measured surfaces

conditions: Both blanks must have similar thickness
Ensure both parts have proper electrical contact
Inspect both pieces separately after cutting

process_sequence.internal_corner_radius: ~R0.15–0.20 mm with 0.25 mm wire — confirm acceptable with designer

process_sequence.name: DRO drilling — Ø6.4 hole
process_sequence.machine: DRO drilling machine (VISPL-TLR-007) or ACE VMC
process_sequence.drill: Ø6.4 mm HSS drill — do not substitute 6.5 mm
sequence: Drill AFTER WEDM — drill breaks through into internal opening, avoiding accidental drilling into lower arm
Clamp component on parallels, top face upward
Pick up finished side and end datums using DRO
Drill Ø6.4 mm through 15 mm top web into opening
Lightly countersink both openings to remove burrs only
process_sequence.note: Drawing tolerance for Ø6.4 is wide — reamer not necessary

process_sequence.name: Chamfering and deburring
process_sequence.caution: Do not create large chamfer on internal measuring faces — interferes with inspection and assembly contact

process_sequence.name: Final inspection
process_sequence.action: Complete dimensional inspection per inspection plan — record actual values

process_sequence.name: Protection
process_sequence.action: Clean and apply light rust-preventive oil. Final visual check.

manual_milling_alternative.applicable_when: WEDM unavailable or internal corner radii are permitted
manual_milling_alternative.cutter: 8 mm end mill (leaves ~R4 corners); 6 mm end mill (leaves ~R3 corners)
steps: Finish vertical and horizontal walls using DRO coordinates
Measure 20.00 mm opening after each finishing pass
manual_milling_alternative.limitation: Leaves R3–R4 internal corners — acceptable only when mating part allows it. Use WEDM when corners mate with another part or drawing shape must be closely maintained.

machine_allocation.equipment: Universal mill (VISPL-TLR-001) or Vertical ram mill (VISPL-TLR-003)
DRO drilling machine (VISPL-TLR-007) or ACE VMC

internal_profile.equipment: Inside micrometer or calibrated slip-gauge stack — vernier alone not adequate

route_summary: Band-saw 52×47×22 mm blank → manual mill outside block to 50×45×20 mm → WEDM internal profile (stack both parts) → DRO drill Ø6.4 through top web → chamfer 0.5×45° and deburr → inspect → clean and protect
